operationalSituations.description: Normal operation — continuous sensor data flow at rated Hz in an ADAS sensor-fusion ECU (see docs/HARA.md §1)
Degraded operation — one sensor stream stopped while others continue (see docs/HARA.md §1)

hazards.description: Late delivery of sensor data causes the fusion algorithm to use stale values (message not delivered within deadline due to GC pause, channel full, or topic mismatch)
Corrupt sensor payload is used in fusion without detection (silent bit corruption during in-process copy; missing CRC/HMAC in the security layer)
Loss of a complete sensor stream without notification (publisher closed or crashed; subscriber channel drained with no liveliness event issued)
Wrong topic routing — data from sensor A is delivered to the handler for sensor B (topic wildcard match error; SEDP routing table corruption)
Overflow of the subscriber channel causes head-of-line blocking (slow consumer; back-pressure policy drops or blocks the publisher goroutine)
Memory exhaustion destabilises the ECU (unbounded history or sequence backlog under Reliable QoS)

safetyGoals.description: go-DDS shall deliver Reliable and BestEffort samples within the configured deadline budget with sufficient margin to avoid stale-perception hazards in the fusing application
safetyGoals.safeState: Application-level: integrator asserts an ADAS inhibit / fallback state when a registered DeadlineQoS callback fires (AoU-03, docs/HARA.md §5)

safetyGoals.description: go-DDS shall provide cryptographic integrity verification for sample payloads so that corrupted or tampered data can be detected before use by the fusion algorithm
safetyGoals.safeState: Application-level: consumer rejects samples that fail HMAC/AES-GCM authentication or E2E CRC verification and falls back to the last known-good sample or a safe default

safetyGoals.description: go-DDS shall notify the application when a publisher stops writing within its configured deadline period so a frozen or lost sensor stream is not silently consumed
safetyGoals.safeState: Application-level: integrator registers a DeadlineQoS missed-deadline callback and asserts a defined safe state on trigger (AoU-03, docs/HARA.md §5)

safetyGoals.description: go-DDS topic matching shall be deterministic and verifiable by integration tests so that data from one sensor topic cannot be silently delivered to a handler for a different topic
safetyGoals.safeState: Application-level: consumer validates payload type/length on receipt; integration tests verify each publisher/subscriber pairing (CONTRIBUTING.md §Test modes)

safetyGoals.description: go-DDS shall provide a bounded-latency delivery path that decouples publisher from subscriber so a slow consumer cannot indefinitely block or unboundedly delay sample delivery
safetyGoals.safeState: safety.DeterministicQueue provides an allocation-free, bounded-latency ring buffer for the final delivery hop; publisher goroutine is never blocked by a slow subscriber

safetyGoals.description: go-DDS shall bound the in-flight history backlog per writer under Reliable QoS so that a persistent ACKNACK loss cannot exhaust ECU memory
safetyGoals.safeState: Application-level: integrator sets a finite ResourceLimitsQoS.MaxSamples on all Reliable QoS publishers (AoU-04, docs/HARA.md §5); History depth enforcement evicts the oldest sample before storing a new one
